config_name: Gigabyte AERO X16 — Ryzen AI 7 350 / RTX 5070, 64GB RAM, 4TB SSD

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 7 350 (8-core: 4 Zen 5 + 4 Zen 5c, Krackan Point)
specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB GDDR7 (85W + 15W Dynamic Boost, MUX switch)
specs.ram_type: DDR5-5600 (2 SO-DIMM slots, max 64GB — this tier fills it)
specs.ports: 1x USB4 40Gbps (PD), 2x USB-A 3.0, 1x USB 2.0, HDMI, gigabit Ethernet, 3.5mm

battery.notes: 76Wh; same efficient platform as reviewed tier.

price.notes: BBY API-verified 2026-11-24, SKU 20256709 reg $5,192.51 / sale $4,292.51. Marketplace seller — third-party fulfillment/return risk, inflated 'reg' anchor. Top AERO X16 tier at BBY CA. Marketplace 5070/16GB/1TB tier (SKU 20340683, $2,507.67) omitted as near-duplicate of the 32GB anchor tier.

reviews.quote: Upgrade options, on the other hand, are very good with expandable RAM and two SSD slots.

praises: Maxed config: 64GB RAM (the platform ceiling) + 4TB across two M.2 slots
Suits heavy video timelines and local AI models that need system RAM headroom
Same NBC-reviewed 84% slim 1.95kg creator chassis with Copilot+ NPU
Best-in-line storage without opening the case
complaints: $4,292 sale for a laptop whose GPU is the NBC-flagged weak point ('barely better than RTX 4070', 8GB VRAM)
Marketplace seller with inflated 'regular' anchor and third-party returns
At this price, OLED creator laptops (Zephyrus G16 class) enter the conversation
Loud fans under gaming load (NBC con)

design_philosophy: The maximum tier of the creator-styled AERO X16: the same slim Zen 5 chassis NBC reviewed at 84%, filled to its stated ceilings — 64GB RAM and 4TB across dual M.2 — for video editors and local-AI users who value RAM capacity over GPU tier. The 8GB-VRAM RTX 5070 remains the platform's compromise at this price.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC's Aero X16 1WH review (84%, 32GB/1TB exact platform): maxed 64GB RAM + 4TB -> productivity +1.0, ai_ml +1.0, creative_work +0.5 vs anchor tier. GPU unchanged, so gaming/screen factors carried.
standouts: Platform-ceiling 64GB RAM + 4TB for creator/AI workloads in a 1.95kg chassis
dealbreakers: 8GB-VRAM RTX 5070 at $4,292 — GPU is the line's weakest link at this price
